sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The two pie charts below show some employment patterns in Great Britain in 1992. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

The key to solving the environmental problems is for the present generation to sacrifice their convenient lifestyle for the sake of future generations. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
